title: FX project file, fx.yaml (fx: project/v1)
description: `fx.yaml` marks a project's root: where runs and the cache live, the default budget and routes, the route tables to load, the providers it declares, where node sources are, and where workflows are found by id.

runs.description: The folder run folders go in, relative to the project root.

cache.description: The store (store.md), relative to the project root.

routes.description: The default route for each capability, used where a step names none. The object form also limits how many calls of the route run at once.

route_tables.description: Route table files (`fx: routes/v1`) to load, relative to the project root. The catalog is built from these tables, in this order (identity.md §7): the built-in default table, left out when any `--routes` file is given; then these tables, in their listed order; then each `--routes <file>`, in the order given. A later table's entry for the same capability and route replaces an earlier one, contract included. Two entries for the same capability and route within one table are refused.

providers.description: Providers the project declares beside FX's own (providers.md §1), by name: the provider part of their routes (`<model>@<name>`). A declaration names the variable its key comes from and the header it is sent in, its base URL and the variable that may move it, the hosts its results may be downloaded from, and the wire it speaks. It is configuration, not identity. Refused while the file is read, beyond this schema: a name FX ships (`gg`, `openai`, `openrouter`, `fal`, `tripo`, `elevenlabs`, `codex`, `grok`); a variable a built-in declaration, an earlier declaration or the same one already reads; a `GRIDA_FX_` variable, a proxy or certificate variable, `PATH` or `HOME`, in any letter case; a default base URL that is not `https`, unless it names a loopback host, or that has userinfo, a query or a fragment.

view_origins.description: Views are planned, not implemented: the origins a view may load from. Recorded in plan.json and otherwise ignored.

sources.description: Packages, beyond the project folder, whose modules count as the project's source: in the identity of node types without a version, and in what fx.lock guards. Each is a Python package name (acme_lib) or an npm package name (@acme/shapes, acme-shapes); each node host is given the names its language can name.

nodes.description: The folder, inside the project, that holds its node modules: what `grida-fx lock` pins.

workflows.description: The folders searched, after the project root's own *.yaml and *.yml files, for a workflow named by its id (store.md, Finding a workflow by id): each folder and every folder below it, in the listed order. Relative to the project root, or absolute; a folder outside the project is allowed, the project root and the folders above it are refused. Setting it replaces the default, and a folder that does not exist adds nothing. A workflow found this way keeps its own home: the nearest fx.yaml at or above its file.

concurrency.description: Overrides the route table's concurrency for this route.

credential.description: Where the key comes from and how it is sent: `<header>: <scheme> <key>`, or `<header>: <key>` when the scheme is empty. Left out, the provider is sent no key and needs none.

download_hosts.description: The hosts a result may be downloaded from, over https: a host, or `*.` and a domain for every host below it (not the domain itself).

family.description: The wire the provider speaks. No adapter serves a family yet: a declared provider's routes plan and price, and a live call on one is refused (no_route).

variable.description: The variable whose value, when set, replaces the default.
An environment variable, named as the `.env` file names one.
